integrity: The accompanying standalone verifier regenerates every finite enumeration; nonequivariant and equivariant arguments are stated explicitly. No external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the 6-vertex octahedral graph only. The integral module is the explicit cube cycle lattice and a natural exact extension, without a claimed integral equivariant splitting. Rational Specht decomposition only; possibly unindexed equivalent prior work.
title: The cubical perfect-matching nerve of the octahedron and its integral equivariant inclusion
